rules.//: Freeze — a runner tagged by a freezer (different-team, within 1m for 2s) writes `frozen_since_ms = now_ms` on themselves. The `not property_age_ms` guard prevents the timer from resetting every tick the freezer stays in range: once frozen, they stay frozen for 30s regardless of continued proximity. After 30s the guard flips back to true and the runner can be re-frozen.

Freezers win — fires the instant every runner's `frozen_since_ms` is within the last 30s (i.e. all runners are simultaneously frozen). Anchored on entity_is: freezer so the rule only broadcasts from a freezer's perspective; duplicate GameEnds from the two freezer nodes are idempotent on receive.

Runners win — fires when the 2-minute timer elapses AND not every runner is currently frozen. The NOT all_entities_property_recent guard is the tiebreaker: at the exact tick the clock hits 120s, if the freezers have simultaneously frozen everyone, freezers_win takes priority; otherwise the runners survived long enough.
